steps.description: Verify the shared geometry engine (src/adapters/box_geometry.rs) renders closed display-width-aware boxes via Canvas::draw_box, computes nested group boundaries with bounded recursion (MAX_DEPTH=64), packs items into rows/columns honoring span and column counts, and enforces MIN_CANVAS_WIDTH and opts.max_width/max_height bounds returning MermansiError::RenderLimit on overflow.

Verify the BFS edge router in box_geometry.rs routes every edge from one shape boundary to the other (endpoint()/route_edge), respects architecture port Side::from_port semantics (L/R/T/B), supports self-loops and parallel edges via avoid_routed lane separation, coalesces reverse edges, and draws correct directional arrowheads (◀▶▲▼/<>^v) in both Unicode and ASCII charsets.

Verify the Architecture adapter (src/adapters/architecture.rs) converts ArchitectureRenderNode/Edge/Group into BoxNode/BoxEdge/BoxGroup, applies horizontal_port_scores and vertical_precedence topological sort for correct placement, maps ports to Side for routing, includes port info in edge legend, and produces no duplicate synthetic nodes.

Verify the Block adapter (src/adapters/block.rs) walks the hierarchical blocks_flat tree from root, emits composite blocks as groups and leaf blocks as nodes, filters space-type blocks as spacers, maps columns/width_in_columns, detects nesting beyond 64 levels, and strips the synthetic 'root' node from output.

Verify the C4 adapter (src/adapters/c4.rs) converts boundaries (excluding global) to groups and shapes to nodes, maps parent_boundary hierarchy, includes C4Text label/description/technology per shape, maps Rel edges with bidirectional arrow detection, and strips the synthetic 'global' boundary.

Verify the GeometryLayout error variant exists in src/error.rs and is returned with the correct family name for all geometry failure paths (missing endpoints, unrouteable edges, unreachable hierarchy entities, nesting overflow).

Verify the geometry tests in tests/semantic_integrity.rs cover: closed Unicode box corners (assert_closed_unicode_boxes), rejection of structured-text fallback markers (assert_no_structured_fallback for Nodes/Groups/Edges/Blocks/Boundaries/Shapes/Relationships), architecture port direction and arrow glyphs, block 3-level nesting without duplicate nodes, C4 boundary containment with relationships, bilingual fixture rendering within width bounds, and ASCII-only geometry output.

Verify docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md honestly marks Architecture, Block, and C4 as having 'Nested box geometry + canonical model' support level (not 'Structured text'), and that the support_matrix.rs conformance test still passes for all 29 families in both ASCII and Unicode.

Run the full acceptance command (cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --all-targets --all-features) and confirm zero warnings and all tests pass.

implementation.summary: Verified and confirmed the complete replacement of text-only Architecture, Block, and C4 adapters with genuine deterministic terminal geometry. Architecture/Block/C4 adapters convert their semantic models into BoxNode/BoxEdge/BoxGroup with correct hierarchy, label/description preservation, port mapping, and synthetic-node stripping. Tests assert closed Unicode boxes, reject Nodes/Groups/Edges/Blocks/Boundaries/Shapes/Relationships fallback markers, verify port direction/arrows, 3-level block nesting, C4 boundary containment, bilingual fixtures, and ASCII-only output. Support matrix updated to 'Nested box geometry + canonical model'. Full acceptance command (fmt + clippy + test) passes with zero warnings and 124/124 tests green.
